```artifact
Feature: Login Functionality

Scenario Outline: Successful login for Doctor, Chemist, and Lab

  Given the system has been set up with default passwords by Admin
  When a user with valid credentials logs in
  Then they should access their respective dashboard

Examples:
  | User Type | Default Password | Expected Dashboard |
  | Doctor    | "doctor123"     | Doctor Dashboard    |
  | Chemist   | "chemist123"    | Chemist Dashboard    |
  | Lab      | "lab123"        | Lab Dashboard       |

Scenario Outline: Unsuccessful login due to incorrect password

  Given the system has been set up with default passwords by Admin
  When a user with invalid credentials logs in
  Then they should receive an error message

Examples:
  | User Type | Default Password | Expected Error Message |
  | Doctor    | "wrongPass"      | "Invalid password"    |
  | Chemist   | "badPass"       | "Invalid password"    |
  | Lab      | "incorrect"     | "Invalid password"    |

Scenario Outline: Unsuccessful login due to non-existent user

  Given the system has been set up with default passwords by Admin
  When a non-existent user attempts to log in
  Then they should receive an error message

Examples:
  | User Type | Expected Error Message |
  | Doctor    | "User not found"     | "Invalid password"    |
  | Chemist   | "User not found"     | "Invalid password"    |
  | Lab      | "User not found"     | "Invalid password"    |

Scenario Outline: Login with expired password

  Given the system has been set up with default passwords by Admin
  When a user with an expired password attempts to log in
  Then they should receive an error message

Examples:
  | User Type | Expected Error Message |
  | Doctor    | "Expired password"   | "Invalid password"    |
  | Chemist   | "Expired password"   | "Invalid password"    |
  | Lab      | "Expired password"   | "Invalid password"    |

Scenario Outline: Login with locked account

  Given the system has been set up with default passwords by Admin
  When a user with a locked account attempts to log in
  Then they should receive an error message

Examples:
  | User Type | Expected Error Message |
  | Doctor    | "Account locked"     | "Invalid password"    |
  | Chemist   | "Account locked"     | "Invalid password"    |
  | Lab      | "Account locked"     | "Invalid password"    |

```
